name: North Yaraq Outpost
title: North Yaraq Outpost
summary: Old starter outpost near Yaraq, never attacked by Martine (acpedia). In the kit it lies on the floor (z 10) of a sandstone canyon whose walls rise 40-70 m: the Life Stone and its sign, a fountain, a small tapered building and a cottage on the floor, a green-lit Empyrean hall on a shelf to the west and a 31 m spire tower on the east mesa (z 50-81); red-flowered trees grow along the canyon floor.

site.name: North Yaraq Outpost
site.notes: Teleport = gazetteer life-stone-near-yaraq-7d68 (canyon floor beside the outpost Life Stone).

shots.standingOrder: Fly north 17 m above the canyon floor between the rock walls toward the North Yaraq outpost, its Life Stone, fountain and Empyrean hall opening ahead; stay 5 m above every tree crown and 15 m off both walls, creatures may be faded.
